Who we are

We help ambitious enterprises move from potential to scale.

Building a business is rarely about solving one problem. A strong product may lack the right funding. A growing enterprise may need better compliance before approaching institutional capital. An established business may have opportunities available through government schemes but lack the expertise to navigate them. ArthoVista exists to bridge those gaps.

Capital intelligence

Identifying the right funding, grants, subsidies and investment opportunities for your business.

Policy intelligence

Navigating government schemes, regulatory frameworks and incentives with clarity.

Documentation discipline

Preparing robust, compliant and investor-ready documentation.

Execution support

Managing end-to-end processes, liaising with institutions and ensuring consistent follow-through.

Access should not be the limit to ambition. Our role is to understand the enterprise, identify the relevant opportunity, structure the requirement and execute the process with discipline — understand, structure, prepare, execute, scale.

Methodology

Five stages. One clear path forward.

Our methodology brings structure to what can otherwise be a complicated funding journey — a repeatable process built for disciplined execution.

  1. 01

    Diagnostic

    Understand before we recommend — eligibility, financial structure, business model, operational position, documentation and policy & scheme compatibility.

  2. 02

    Financial architecture

    Structure the opportunity — debt-equity considerations, subsidy opportunities, funding mix, capital requirement and documentation architecture.

  3. 03

    Submission

    Prepare with precision — application preparation, DPR and supporting documents, compliance readiness and submission management.

  4. 04

    Approval

    Stay with the process — query management, stakeholder coordination, application follow-up and process monitoring.

  5. 05

    Disbursement

    From sanction to capital — sanction coordination, capital receipt and ongoing compliance support.

Honest expectations. Outcomes depend on eligibility, scheme criteria, documentation and the institutions’ own review. We are transparent about what is realistic for your case before you proceed — we do not guarantee approvals.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers to the questions enterprises ask us most.

What does ArthoVista do?

ArthoVista is a strategic business advisory and capital-access partner. We help Indian enterprises across five areas — Build (business setup and certifications), Fund (government schemes, grants & CSR, private and institutional capital), Comply (ROC, GST and annual compliance), Grow (brand, digital and investor materials) and Scale (capital architecture and long-term enterprise support).

Which businesses does ArthoVista work with?

We work with ambitious Indian enterprises across the full journey — from businesses still forming their foundation to established companies preparing to scale. We have particular depth in agri-tech & aquaculture, pharma & medical, manufacturing, and agri-tech & startups.

Does ArthoVista only help with government funding?

No. We work across four capital channels: government funding (120+ schemes across 26+ ministries, including PMEGP, MUDRA, PLI and CLCSS), grants & CSR capital, private capital (Tier-1 VCs, HNIs, angels and family offices) and institutional finance. The right mix depends on your stage, sector and business model.

How does the 5-stage methodology work?

We follow a repeatable process: 01 Diagnostic (understand your eligibility, financial structure and policy compatibility before recommending anything), 02 Financial Architecture, 03 Submission, 04 Approval and 05 Disbursement. Every mandate follows the same path, so you always know what is happening and why.

Can ArthoVista guarantee that a grant or loan will be approved?

No, and we are transparent about that from the start. Outcomes depend on your eligibility, scheme-specific criteria, documentation quality and the deciding institutions. Our role is to prepare, structure and execute with discipline — and to tell you honestly what is realistic for your case before you commit.

What services does ArthoVista provide beyond funding?

A full stack: business registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC, Partnership and Section 8), certifications & licensing (ISO, FSSAI, IEC, GeM, Udyam, Startup India and more), annual compliance (ROC, GST, governance), investor pitch decks & Detailed Project Reports, and digital marketing & brand strategy.

Where is ArthoVista based?

Our corporate HQ is in Noida, with teams in New Delhi (policy & regulatory), Lucknow, Indore and Amravati. We work with enterprises pan-India through scheduled consultations and remote execution.
